title: Publish shared negative-only capacity configuration contract

conditions.description: As owner of the common default-off configuration and manual negative vertical, record the exact configuration name, scope, default, read API, base/source commit and allowed consumer wiring as soon as chosen; include disconnected local schedule behavior and tests. W19 owns Program.fs scheduled caller and must consume this same contract; do not edit that lease. This is a one-way contract handoff, not a claim of positive admission or production authority. Resolve with concrete evidence so Lead can reconcile W19's blocked task.
